description: Correct a quantity-tracked item's stock at ONE location: "we used up 12 batteries", "50 arrived", "recounted: there are 7". Exactly one of delta (relative: negative = used up, positive = received) or setTo (absolute recount). kind states the intent (usage | receipt | correction; inferred from the argument shape when absent); reason is a short note for the activity timeline. A negative delta past the location's unreserved stock is rejected (the error names the amounts); a setTo recount always records the count, even below reservations. A restock task opens automatically when a location's AVAILABLE stock (on hand minus what active orders reserved) drops below its threshold, so a location can be low with a full shelf. The result returns every stocked level as distribution: { locationId, name, kind: location|person, quantity, available, reserved?, minStock?, isLow? }, the same row shape check_item_availability returns, so isLow shows whether this adjustment took the location under its threshold. transfer_stock moves stock between locations; serialized items change through assign_item and set_item_status. Requires the manager role. Not idempotent: a repeated delta applies twice (a repeated setTo does not change the count again).

delta.description: Relative change: negative = used up, positive = received (exactly one of delta/setTo)

itemId.description: Item id (must be a quantity-tracked item)

kind.description: Intent for the activity timeline; inferred from the argument shape when absent

locationId.description: Location (or stock-holding person) resource id, from search_resources or check_item_availability's distribution

reason.description: Short reason, shown in the item's activity timeline

setTo.description: Absolute recount — the new quantity at this location

name: adjust_stock

distribution.description: Every stocked level after the change — the SAME row shape check_item_availability returns

available.description: Freely usable stock: quantity minus reserved, floored at 0. Always present

isLow.description: True when available < minStock. Present only alongside minStock — absent means no threshold is set here, NOT that the level is healthy

locationId.description: Resource id of this place — pass it straight to adjust_stock, set_min_stock or transfer_stock (no search_resources round-trip needed)

locationName.description: DEPRECATED — the same string as `name`, kept only for clients whose tool list froze before the rename

minStock.description: Restock threshold here (absent when none is set)

reserved.description: Of that, promised to active orders (absent when 0)

newLevelQuantity.description: The adjusted location's stock after the change

title: Adjust stock
